_comment: Test data lives here, not in source. `default` is the route the main happy-path test runs in depth (also used by validation and edge cases), overridable by environment variables - see README > Configuring what the suite tests. `scenarios` holds additional routes checked more lightly in find-trains.spec.ts; add a route or passenger mix here to widen that coverage, no code changes needed. Deliberately doesn't repeat the default route - that one's already covered in depth.

scenarios.name: single traveler one way - Washington to Philadelphia
two adults round trip - Philadelphia to Washington
